key_area: Canonical six-level IC ladder for product managers who own discovery-to-delivery outcomes for a product area or capability, consolidated by union from five independent sources; P3 Senior Product Manager is the terminal level.

P1: Associate Product Manager
P2: Product Manager
P3: Senior Product Manager
P4: Staff/Group Product Manager
P5: Principal Product Manager
P6: Distinguished PM / Head of Product Craft

P1: one feature/epic
P2: a product area
P3: a product/capability (terminal level)
P4: multiple product areas
P5: product organization
P6: company portfolio

P1: Learns the craft; ships well-defined slices with guidance
